91936847.description: 5F-SDB-006 is a drug that acts as a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with an EC50 of 50 nM for human CB1 receptors, and 123 nM for human CB2 receptors.

92043599.name: Epoetin alfa
92043599.description: Epoetin alfa, sold under the brand name Epogen among others, is a human erythropoietin produced in cell culture using recombinant DNA technology.

101418447.name: Cyaphide
101418447.description: In chemistry, the cyaphide ion is an anionic organophosphorus species that possesses a triple bond between carbon and phosphorus.

102336591.name: 6-EAPB
102336591.description: 6-EAPB, also known as 1- -N-ethylpropan-2-amine, is a potentially psychedelic and potentially entactogenic drug of the benzofuran class; it is structurally related to 6-APB and MDMA.

122706255.name: Cembratrienol
122706255.description: Cembratrienol is a tertiary alcohol produced in the leaves of tobacco plants. It acts as an insect repellent.

124201807.name: 4-Methylpentedrone
124201807.description: 4-Methylpentedrone (also known as 4-MPD and 4-Methyl-α-methylamino-valerophenone), is a stimulant medication of the cathinone class, invented in 1960 .

134517711.name: Soquelitinib
134517711.description: Soquelitinib is an experimental drug which acts as a selective inhibitor of the enzyme interleukin-2-inducible T-cell kinase . It is in clinical trials for the treatment of T-cell lymphoma.

135565903.name: Opicapone
135565903.description: Opicapone, sold under the brand name Ongentys, is a medication which is administered together with levodopa in people with Parkinson's disease.

136864975.name: Pterorhodin
136864975.description: Pterorhodin is a pteridine pigment found in animals and plants.

146026959.name: Ropanicant
146026959.description: Ropanicant is an investigational new drug under development by Suven Life Sciences Ltd for the treatment of major depressive disorder and certain neurological conditions.

162625103.name: Ecnoglutide
162625103.description: Ecnoglutide is a GLP-1 agonist being developed for the treatment of obesity and type 2 diabetes.

172871887.name: CUMYL-3TMS-PRINACA
172871887.description: CUMYL-3TMS-PRINACA is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist that has been sold as a designer drug, first identified in Sweden in May 2023.

177844175.name: (S)-MK-26
177844175.description: -MK-26 is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor that was derived from modafinil.

900000079.name: ARCT-021
900000079.description: ARCT-021, also known as LUNAR-COV19, is a COVID-19 vaccine candidate developed by Arcturus Therapeutics.

900000335.name: Butodesnitazene
900000335.description: Butodesnitazene is a benzimidazole derivative with opioid effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

900000463.name: Chymopapain
900000463.description: Chymopapain (EC 3.4.22.6, chymopapain A, chymopapain B, chymopapain S, brand name Chymodiactin) is a proteolytic enzyme isolated from the latex of papaya .

900000719.name: Enoticumab
900000719.description: Enoticumab is a human monoclonal antibody that binds to DLL4. It acts as an immunomodulator.

900000847.name: Fomivirsen
900000847.description: Fomivirsen is an antisense antiviral drug that was used in the treatment of cytomegalovirus retinitis in immunocompromised patients, including those with AIDS.

900001231.name: Manganese trioxide fluoride
900001231.description: Manganese trioxide fluoride is an inorganic compound with the formula MnO3F.

900001487.name: Pateclizumab
900001487.description: Pateclizumab is an immunomodulator. It binds to lymphotoxin alpha. This drug was developed by Genentech/Roche.
